newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison to launch HK$10 billion loan.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison to launch HK$10 billion loan.

text.p: HSBC Investment Bank Asia and Chase Manhattan Asia were inviting banks to join as underwriters for Hutchison Whampoa's HK$10 billion term loan facility, arranger HSBC Investment Bank Asia said on Tuesday.
The five-year facility includes one year as a revolving credit facility before converting to a straight loan for the remaining four years.
It pays a margin of 39 basis points over the one-, two-, three- and six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
An underwriting group is being formed.
